documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold reported a 144.69% year-on-year revenue growth in Q1 FY27, driven by healthy volume expansion and the commencement of operations at its new Marol manufacturing facility. Management provided guidance for 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth for the current year, targeting a top line of INR 3,500 crores. The company is pursuing further expansion through an upcoming Jaipur facility and a new office in Dubai, supported by a proposed INR 100 crore rights issue. Shanti Gold International Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting strong financial and operational growth including a revenue increase to Rs 716.4 Cr and a net profit of Rs 50.5 Cr. The company highlighted ongoing capacity expansion with the commissioning of a Marol facility adding ~4,000 kg per annum and an upcoming Jaipur facility adding 1,200 kg per annum.

guidance.claim: The company expects value growth of 50% to 60% for the current year.
guidance.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year.

guidance.claim: Management targets a revenue of INR 3,500 crores for the current year.
guidance.quote: See, basically, the guidance as of now, we are sticking to the guidance of INR3,500 crores.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates volume growth between 30% and 40% compared to the previous year.
guidance.quote: So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

guidance.claim: Management expects a sustainable EBITDA margin between 7.5% and 8%.
guidance.quote: But going forward, we don't see that, because the gold is still moving in a narrow band, so we expect the margin should be around 7.5% to 8% EBITDA this year.

guidance.claim: The company targets a PAT margin of approximately 4%.
The company expects volume growth of 30% to 40% and value growth of 60% to 70% in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

guidance.claim: Management expects a turnover of approximately INR 3,000 crores to INR 3,500 crores next year.
guidance.quote: So next year like around we expecting a turnover of around INR 3,000 crores to INR 3,500 crores and with 35% to 40% growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects to reach full capacity of 7,900 kilograms within three to four years.
guidance.quote: Yes, three to four years, we should achieve full 7,900 kilos or maybe more.

demand_outlook.claim: Management maintains a constructive outlook for the organized jewellery market in India.
demand_outlook.quote: From an industry perspective, the outlook for the organized jewellery continues to remain constructive.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is supported by weddings, occasions, and rising disposable incomes.
demand_outlook.quote: India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed significant demand following recent exhibitions.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is, as I said, we just exhibited from the exhibition and we've come and we have a huge demand in export as well as in local.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted rising disposable income drives gold as a status symbol and investment.
demand_outlook.quote:
Rising Middle Class
Growing disposable income drives gold as status symbol & investment

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted seasonal demand from weddings, Diwali, and harvest festivals.
demand_outlook.quote:
Weddings & Festivals
Seasonal demand from weddings, Diwali & harvest festivals

demand_outlook.claim: Management mentioned that unique Indian designs are attracting global buyers with export growth potential.
demand_outlook.quote:
Export Opportunity
Unique Indian designs attracting global buyers; export growth potential

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted branded players are driving consumer trust.
demand_outlook.quote:
Organised Shift
Branded players (Tanishq, Kalyan, Malabar) driving consumer trust

demand_outlook.claim: Demand trends remained resilient across key markets despite elevated gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a structural shift from unorganized to organized jewellery retail creating outsourcing opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The structural shift from unorganized to organized jewellery retail continues to gather pace, which is creating meaningful outsourcing opportunities for manufacturers with proven execution capabilities.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is witnessing healthy transactions in wedding and occasion-led jewellery categories.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects export contribution to increase from 10% to 20%.
demand_outlook.quote: So I told you like this year will be like from 5% to we are going to go up to 10% or maybe more. Sorry, from 10% to 20%.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commenced operations at its new Marol manufacturing facility in Mumbai during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Jaipur facility is expected to be operational by November or December with a capex of INR 47 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jaipur plant is situated on 3 acres of land with a 50,000 square foot first phase.
capex_expansion.quote: Jaipur factory is actually spread across 3 acres of land, and this 50,000 is just one segment of those, of the whole plant that we have.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is establishing a Dubai office to expand its international footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: Dubai office will increase our international footprint over a period of time.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol facility in Mumbai will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The Marol factory is expected to be ready in about a month.
capex_expansion.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory

capex_expansion.claim: A new 1,200 kilo per annum capacity facility in Jaipur is expected to start by September or October.
capex_expansion.quote: I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

capex_expansion.claim: Total installed manufacturing capacity will reach nearly 7,900 kilograms per annum once new facilities are operational.
capex_expansion.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 was 9.97%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR71.45 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 9.97%.

margins_costs.claim: A change in inventory valuation method from FIFO to WAC resulted in a 2% to 2.5% unrealized gain.
margins_costs.quote: See, there was a change in inventory method from FIFO to WAC method. There was some unrealized gain which was locked in the inventory of last year, which got spilled in this current year. So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses increased by 132% to support the company's growth trajectory.
margins_costs.quote: Basically these are expenses which is required to support our sales trajectory, growth trajectory, and this is in line with the growth because if you see the top line it has grown by 144 percentage.

margins_costs.claim: For FY26, gross margin was 10.9%, EBITDA margin was 9.9%, and PAT margin was 6.9%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin: 10.9% EBITDA Margin: 9.9% PAT Margin: 6.9%

margins_costs.claim: The company transitioned its inventory valuation from FIFO to the weighted average cost method.
margins_costs.quote: The company has transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from the First In, First Out, FIFO method to the weighted average cost WAC method with retrospective effect from April 01, 2024.

orders_capacity.claim: The existing manufacturing facility is currently operating at 75% capacity utilization.
Studded jewellery accounts for 75% of the company's revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: 75% of the revenue is from our designer jewellery and 25% from plain gold jewellery.

orders_capacity.claim: The existing Andheri manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels

orders_capacity.claim: Quarterly volumes are approximately 145 kilos to 150 kilos.
orders_capacity.quote: So we have given out our volumes on a quarterly basis in our presentation around 145 kilos to 150 kilos.

capital_allocation.claim: The company approved a rights issue to raise up to INR 100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The current debt-to-equity ratio is 0.50, with a plan to keep it below 1x.
capital_allocation.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

capital_allocation.claim: The current debt-equity ratio stands at 0.36.
capital_allocation.quote: At currently, we are at 0.36, which is again a good headspace to maneuver or go for that debt part.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a disciplined approach to working capital and balance sheet strength.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a disciplined approach towards working capital management, operational efficiency, and balance sheet strength while continuing to invest in future growth opportunities.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is awaiting RBI approval for its Dubai office operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Once that is in place, things will be set up, and that will increase – Dubai office will increase our international footprint over a period of time. So as of now, the export part comprises of 4% of the total revenue for Q1.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions have delayed the full operationalization of the Dubai subsidiary.
risks_headwinds.quote: So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good.

risks_headwinds.claim: High gold prices and market volatility may require extending credit support to customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: Going forward, yes, if the markets are turbulent, we are going in a turbulent time, we may have to extend some kind of support to our customer
